claim: Trappers' Huts hunt rabbits from Winter Pines planted by a Foresters' Hub, not only from wild trees.

evidence.reference: Maintainer report in chat, 26 October 2026: a player asked whether Trappers' Huts collect meat and hide from Foresters' Hub trees; the maintainer checked in play and they do.

notes: The game files agree: rabbit burrows are spawned by the Winter Pine itself (a Burrow Spawner on the tree prefab: at most 1 burrow per pine, a new one every 6 to 10 days). Because the spawner is part of the tree, a planted pine grows burrows the same way a wild one does. Each rabbit gives 2 Meat and 1 Animal Hide (Trappers' Hut field guide).
